principles: Full user request and explicit restrictions remain authoritative.
Never infer hidden chain-of-thought, permission state, or support from a model name.
Default to a single worker; delegate only independent bounded work.
Safety checks and required acceptance gates are not optional budget items.
A routing plan is advisory and never executes tools.

stages: Locate exact behavior and neighboring contract
Inspect relevant call path and existing patterns
Run focused and relevant package checks
Review integrated diff, report and stop

deep.purpose: High risk, unclear lifecycle, or cross-cutting changes
stages: Map affected interfaces, state, failure paths, and invariants
Compare approaches and choose with explicit risk controls
Implement in checkable increments; keep rollback possible
Run impacted checks and mandated integration/security tests
Review actual integrated change and unresolved risks

requires: explicit user request or clearly justified workload
two or more independently owned tasks
non-overlapping write ownership or agreed interface/worktrees
explicit task contracts, expected outputs, and integration owner
parallel.action: Offer parallel plan; do not launch workers

continuous.action: Propose event-triggered iteration; do not create scheduler or run background work

requires: stable revision/diff or defined evidence target
review.action: Read-only focused review by default; do not silently modify code

codex.strategy: Direct goals and minimal context; use skill only when relevant; rely on documented reasoning settings, don't force chain-of-thought scripts.
codex.workers: independent bounded ownership; avoid duplicate exploration
rules: Do not compel verbose reasoning traces
Review stable diff once, reopen when it changes

claude.strategy: Respect native adaptive thinking/effort; fresh subagent contexts need task-specific evidence; avoid model-setting changes without approval.
claude.workers: fresh context; hand off file ranges, constraints and concise evidence; no needless team

gemini.strategy: Native skill activation and user consent; subagents have isolated contexts and configurable tools/max_turns/timeout_mins.
gemini.tool_selection: activate_skill with consent; restrict worker tools
gemini.workers: avoid subagent recursion; bound max turns and handoffs
rules: GEMINI.md is persistent context; SKILL.md is on-demand
Never grant wildcard tools merely for convenience

cursor.strategy: Context-isolated foreground/background subagents; cloud agents may have separate filesystem/security.
cursor.workers: use isolated ownership and review returned artifacts
rules: Never assume local global skills are available to cloud agents

opencode.strategy: Plan/build are distinct primary agents; specialized subagents are optional and permission-scoped.
opencode.workers: separate plan/review from write, as permissions permit
rules: Do not override configured tool permissions
Avoid creating agents solely for ceremony

copilot.strategy: Well-scoped issues, repository instructions and CI-based evidence; cloud agent environment may differ from local.
copilot.workers: review PR diff and CI; keep scope limited
rules: Do not assume installed local CLI equals cloud environment

generic.strategy: Portable skill with minimal default assumptions; rely on available native capabilities.
generic.tool_selection: explicit catalog or native tool discovery
rules: No hidden prompt or reasoning access
